name: Ascent Protocol: A Life Earned
description: Commissioned by the OmniVeil corponation and distributed free of charge to all Tier 1-3 residents in OmniVeil sectors, this glossy holographic feature dramatizes the rise of Cael Andriessen-Park from a Shelf orphan to a celebrated OmniVeil logistics manager. Every obstacle in Cael's life is framed as a failure of personal discipline rather than structural inequality, and the film's climax — a formal induction ceremony into OmniVeil's Loyalty Tier — is designed to trigger BCI reward pathways. Critics outside OmniVeil territory immediately identified it as a behavioral conditioning vehicle.
cultural_impact: Normalized the concept of 'Loyalty Tier' as aspirational rather than coercive, and measurably increased voluntary OmniVeil labor contract signings by 31% in the year following release.
story_hooks: A neuroscientist who helped design the reward-trigger sequences is now trying to distribute a counter-protocol — a short audio file that neutralizes the conditioning.
The real Cael Andriessen-Park exists and is nothing like the film's protagonist; they want the record corrected and their likeness back.
Someone has edited the BCI reward layer to trigger at scenes depicting OmniVeil's antagonists instead — and the modified version is spreading through pirate mesh.
